title: Nebraska Cornhuskers with Skarlett Jones secure victory over Arkansas in NCAA Tournament on May 28
text:
Nebraska Cornhuskers with Skarlett Jones secure victory over Arkansas in NCAA Tournament on May 28
On Thursday, May 28, Skarlett Jones, a Gretna High School graduate and utility player for the Nebraska Cornhuskers, contributed to the team's 5-3 victory over the Arkansas Razorbacks in the NCAA Tournament.
The matchup was held at Devon Park and began at 8:30 p.m.
Nebraska is scheduled to play its next game at Devon Park on Saturday, May 30, at 6 p.m.
Skarlett Jones — Utility player — Freshman — 5′10″ — Hometown: Gretna
